rationale.intuition: Yale RD intl admit 11% (CDS) — UK applicants benefit from cultural/linguistic fit and AO familiarity with A-Levels. A*A*A* maps to ~3.95-4.0 unweighted in AO normalization (top 5-7% of UK cohort). Humanities profile aligns with Yale's strength. SAT 1540 in 50th-percentile range. UK applicants face lighter penalty than Asian intl pools (~0.6-0.8x overall vs 0.4-0.5x for CN/IN). Industry: T5 RD UK humanities strong cluster 4-12%.

sources.name: Yale CDS 2024-25
sources.evidence: Overall admit 4.75%; intl admit 11%. UK is among most-represented European sending countries.

sources.name: Yale International Admissions Briefing 2024
sources.evidence: A-Levels accepted as primary credential for UK applicants; A* grades treated as top-tier with no further conversion needed.

sources.name: Ivy Coach UK Applicants Benchmark 2024
sources.evidence: UK humanities applicants at Yale RD cluster 4-12% per published case data; lighter Asian-bucket competition.
